definitions.explanation: The point where rivers, roads, or traffic lanes come together and merge into one.

definitions.gloss: joining up, meeting up, linking up
definitions.explanation: People or groups coming together to join forces, meet at a point, or unite for a common purpose.

notes:
{合流|ごうりゅう} means coming together and merging into one, used for both physical things (rivers, roads) and people meeting up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{合流|ごうりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: rivers merge
- {合流|ごうりゅう}⟦{地点|ちてん}→地点：04058_chiten⟧: merging point, confluence
- {合流|ごうりゅう}レーン: merging lane (highway)
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{合流|ごうりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to join up with, to meet up with

USAGE BY SENSE:
Sense 1 (physical): Most commonly used with rivers and roads/traffic. {合流|ごうりゅう}⟦{地点|ちてん}→地点：04058_chiten⟧ frequently appears in traffic reports.

Sense 2 (people): Very common in everyday conversation for meeting up with others at a location. Often used when people who traveled separately come together: ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{合流|ごうりゅう}⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧ (Let's meet up there).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧: merging of organizations or companies
- ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧: gathering, assembling (more formal for meeting up)
